title: Sniffer's Dandelions
description: Moves golden dandelions to be a sniffer drop, rather than crafted.
body:
The new golden dandelions are a little odd - why are they crafted? They don't really interact with any other game features. This mod removes the crafting recipe and makes it so golden dandelions are now obtained from sniffers, like torchflowers and pitcher pods are.

This mod also makes golden dandelions infinitely bonemealable, like tall flowers are, because sniffer farms are a pain to make.

This mod functions purely server-side.
